tasks.description: Add a light/dark theme toggle control in the application's Settings page. The toggle should immediately switch the active theme. This control should be accessible and follow the existing design tokens.
acceptance_criteria: Given the user is on the Settings page, when the theme toggle is clicked, then the active theme is switched.

tasks.description: Persist the user's selected theme to localStorage so the same theme is applied automatically on the user's next visit. Ensure that the theme is stored securely and efficiently.
acceptance_criteria: Given the user has selected a theme, when the user closes and reopens the application, then the previously selected theme is applied.

tasks.description: On the first load, when the user has no stored preference, honor the operating system setting via the prefers-color-scheme media query to choose the initial theme. Ensure this works across different operating systems and browsers.
acceptance_criteria: Given the user has no stored theme preference, when the application is loaded, then the theme is set based on the operating system's preferred color scheme.

tasks.description: Apply the active theme consistently to all pages and shared components of the application. Ensure that the theme is applied efficiently and does not cause any performance issues.
acceptance_criteria: Given the user has selected a theme, when the user navigates to any page or component, then the selected theme is applied consistently.

tasks.description: Test the theme toggle functionality to ensure it works as expected across different browsers, operating systems, and devices. Test for any potential bugs or issues.
acceptance_criteria: Given the theme toggle is clicked, when the application is tested across different browsers, operating systems, and devices, then the theme toggle works as expected without any issues.
